dedupe_keys.name: quality assured spatial dataset of wildfire containment firelines and engagement outcomes 2017 to 2024

description: Quality assured spatial dataset of wildfire containment firelines and engagement outcomes 2017 to 2024 is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Alexander Arkowitz et al. The escalation of wildfires in the USA, coupled with rising firefighting costs and decreasing workforce capacity, motivates evaluating the efficiency and effectiveness of containment measures. However, the existing spatial data that records the locations and types of containment measures and wildfire perimeters contains numerous errors and redundancies. Coverage: national (US); published in 2025. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The only repository address found in the article is the code repository in GitHub named in its Code Availability section; the data may be hosted elsewhere, as the Data Records section of the article states. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
